name: U42-5-receipt-360-200
steps: (()=>{const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('.work-screen')].at(-1);const b=s.querySelector('.screen__body').getBoundingClientRect();const g=s.querySelector('.work-review');if(!g)throw Error('No review actions');const r=g.getBoundingClientRect();if(s.querySelector('.screen__footer'))throw Error('Review actions still in a footer');return JSON.stringify({body:[Math.round(b.top),Math.round(b.bottom)],review:[Math.round(r.top),Math.round(r.bottom)],whole:r.top>=b.top&&r.bottom<=b.bottom})})()

name: U42-6-stop-360-200
steps: (async()=>{const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const h=window.__sim.host;const send=body=>h.command({command_id:crypto.randomUUID(),issued_at:Date.now(),expires_at:null,expected_revision:null,body});await send({command:'send_message',task_id:ids.tDash,text:'Also check the p99 line.',bundle:null,delivery:'next_turn'});await send({command:'send_message',task_id:ids.tDash,text:'Then screenshot the legend.',bundle:null,delivery:'next_turn'});await send({command:'stop_task',task_id:ids.tDash})})()

(()=>{const r=document.querySelector('.control-receipt');if(!r)throw Error('No computer receipt');const last=[...r.querySelectorAll('li')].at(-1).innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ');if(!last.startsWith('Held messages withdrawn · 2'))throw Error('Missing held line: '+last);[...r.querySelectorAll('li')].at(-1).scrollIntoView({block:'end'});return last})()

name: U42-7-terminal-360-200
steps: (()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.terminal-screen');const b=s.querySelector('.screen__body').getBoundingClientRect();const f=s.querySelector('.terminal-frame').getBoundingClientRect();const row=[...s.querySelectorAll('.xterm-rows > div')].filter(d=>d.textContent.trim()).at(-1);const r=row.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.top<b.top||r.bottom>b.bottom+0.5)throw Error('Latest row out of view: '+JSON.stringify([r.top,r.bottom,b.top,b.bottom]));if(f.bottom>b.bottom+0.5)throw Error('Output runs '+(f.bottom-b.bottom)+' px below the view');return 'latest row '+JSON.stringify(row.textContent.trim())+' at '+Math.round(r.bottom)+' of '+Math.round(b.bottom)})()

(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.terminal-screen');const b=s.querySelector('.screen__body').getBoundingClientRect();const btn=s.querySelector('.terminal-recovery .btn');if(!btn)throw Error('No Reconnect');const r=btn.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.top<b.top||r.bottom>b.bottom+0.5)throw Error('Reconnect clipped by '+(r.bottom-b.bottom)+' px');return btn.textContent+' whole, '+Math.round(b.bottom-r.bottom)+' px to spare'})()
